manual.label: Credit or debit a wallet by hand
manual.help: When on, a team member with the "wallet" permission can add credit to a customer's wallet or take it off by hand, always with a reason and a note (a goodwill credit, a correction the customer agreed to). Every entry is a new line in the wallet's ledger and in the audit log; nothing is ever edited or deleted, and a mistake is put right with a new entry the other way. "Largest entry": the most one entry may be (empty = no limit). A debit never takes a wallet below zero. Off: nobody can change a wallet by hand.

apology.label: Late-delivery apology credit
apology.help: Whether a customer whose parcel came late may get an apology credit in his wallet. "Per order": a team member gives it on the order and types the amount (up to the limit). "By rule": the amount follows from your rule — a fixed amount, or a percentage of the order's goods — and it can only be given once the order came this many hours later than its promise. One credit per order. "Most per order": the limit (empty = no limit). The credit is store credit in the wallet; nothing is paid out and no price changes. Off: no apology credit is given.
